review_comments.body:
Could we check `Close()` directly here? On Windows, `Stat()` on the closed file returns an invalid-handle error, so the assertion fails. [Failed CI job](https://github.com/acronis/go-appkit/actions/runs/44230299467/job/134639335399?pr=68)

```text
expected: "file already closed"
in chain: "GetFileType ...: The handle is invalid."
```

A second `Close()` returns `os.ErrClosed` on both Windows and Unix. If the reader was left open, it returns `nil` and the test catches the leak.

```suggestion
		require.ErrorIs(t, body.Close(), os.ErrClosed, "GetBody reader must be closed")
```

comments.body:
Thanks @vasayxtx. The test now checks `Close()` directly instead of calling `Stat()` on the closed file, which avoids the invalid-handle error on Windows (e71a967).

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
@pcbeingused333, merged, thank you for the fix
